description: A table of contents for this user's memory: which sources are connected (email, calendar, docs, …), how many items each holds, and the top people, topics and projects. It is an index rather than an answer — it contains no message bodies, no dates and no content, so it establishes that a source exists without saying anything about what is in it. The content behind any entry it lists is retrievable with cortex_ask.
name: cortex_manifest
title: What the user’s memory contains
